source.text: Between September 24, 2013 and September 27, 2013, Kirkland and outside counsel to Mr. MacDonald negotiated the terms of the MacDonald voting agreements, which were entered into by Mr. MacDonald, his wife and one of his trusts on September 27, 2013, and which became effective upon entry into the merger agreement.

state.target_event: MacDonald, his wife and trust entered voting agreements on September 27, 2013.
